summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K reporting a new natural gas discovery at the Sandia-1 exploratory well offshore Colombia. Petrobras, as operator with a 44.44% interest, confirmed gas zones in deep waters, with appraisals ongoing. This is an operational exploration update, not a special situation. No transaction, stake change, or corporate action is involved. The filing contains routine operational news and forward-looking statements. No deal terms or advisors are mentioned. There is no event requiring special-situations classification.
